items.ruling_applied: manual §3.1 rules 1 and 4 (C1, worked example 'Pembrolizumab + an investigational vaccine')
items.reason: Although the arm is registered '[ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] DC Vaccine + Pembrolizumab Arm', the record makes pembrolizumab the randomised question: patients 'will be randomized to receive either pembrolizumab or a placebo as an addition to the experimental treatment regimen'. A placebo-controlled add-on is investigational, not a comparator. Rule 1 read literally on the arm type would say control_comparator, so the arm label conflicts with the text.

Pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological agent; the DC vaccine is an excluded type ('allogeneic dendritic cells derived from healthy donors fused with autologous tumor cells'), matching the manual's 'Pembrolizumab + an investigational vaccine' example.

For the pembrolizumab question, the comparator is vaccine plus placebo, i.e. the EXPERIMENTAL-labelled 'DC Vaccine Arm' ('randomized to receive either pembrolizumab or a placebo as an addition'), so an EXPERIMENTAL-labelled arm works as the control. The [CODE] control_arm is yes anyway because of the PLACEBO_COMPARATOR arm.

note: S6 rests on reading pembrolizumab as investigational despite its arm being registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR; no ruling covers a mislabelled arm type, so XL should confirm. Both coders listed an IDH eligibility row ('confirmed IDH status'); no IDH value is required and it only defines the GBM diagnosis, so any_molecular_selection is proposed false.
